title: California Dreamin' — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “California Dreamin'”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Introduction: C#m | B | A | E | G#sus4 | G#7 (repeat 2×)
Verse 1: C#m | B | A | E | G#sus4 | G#7 (repeat 2×)
Refrain 1: C#m | B | A | E | G#sus4 | G#7 (repeat 2×)
Verse 2: C#m | B | A | E | G#sus4 | G#7 (repeat 2×)
Instrumental space: C#m | B | A | E | G#sus4 | G#7 (repeat 1×)
Refrain 2: C#m | B | A | E | G#sus4 | G#7 (repeat 1×)
Ending: C#m | B | A | G#7 | C#m (repeat 1×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Taut minor-key guitar rhythm, suspension before G#7, with bright E-major relative motion. No recording flute-solo transcription.
Score section map: Introduction (1–12) · Verse 1 (13–24) · Refrain 1 (25–36) · Verse 2 (37–48) · Instrumental space (49–54) · Refrain 2 (55–60) · Ending (61–65).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://www.modernguitartuition.com/all-posts/how-to-play-california-dreaming-by-the-mamas-and-the-papas
